scope: Structural tail inventory inside the already-covered 1101/n5/v4 cell. Fixed threshold >1945 and three explicit neighbor bands; no new selection or ranking.

population.mask_rule: positive value at/above whole-population p90; zero always low; ties stay together
population.tail_bin: greater than last inclusive upper bound

fixed_control.counting: This is the same old n5 anchor. Its prospective repeats add observations only, not a new historical or comparable identity.

structural_quantile_method: Nearest rank ceil(q*N), independently across each complete segment and its historically eligible remainder. Empty capacity has null quantiles.
sampling_design_constraints: Freeze quotas and deterministic structural selection separately by the three tail bands after reviewing capacity. A preregistered maximum-neighbor representative plus one fixed-hash remainder can guarantee upper-end representation; maximum-neighbor ties can use the frozen hash and original ordinal. Exclude all 226 historical identities from new queries. Do not choose by measured timings, resample, replace seeds, transfer quota, or use the fixed control as a new query. This inventory selects no identities.
interpretation: Tail-specific deliberate sampling cannot be treated as an unbiased whole-cell estimate. All 55 cells were already covered; new evidence strengthens only the stated tail bands. The original V6 n5 anchor supplies same-window context with separately retained historical costs.
privacy: Aggregate capacities, structural quantiles, cost summaries and source fingerprints only; no per-query keys, identity hashes or selected ordinals.
